China Conducts Missile Test and Patrols in Pacific

China has conducted a long-range ballistic missile test from a submarine in the South Pacific. Concurrently, Chinese coast guard patrols were launched east of Taiwan. These actions have reportedly sparked regional alarm and are viewed by some as a test for India, particularly in light of joint naval drills with Russia.
